correctness.rationale: From the exact Dirichlet–multinomial mass function, one-category empty/two-occupancy probabilities and the ordered distinct-category mixed event give \(\operatorname{Cov}(C_0,C_2)=k^2uv(R_N-1)\). Cancellation proves \(R_{N+1}/R_N=1-a(a+2)/[((k-1)a+N-2)((k-1)a+N)]\in(0,1)\). The initial value \(R_2>1\), and digamma concavity strictly decreases the real gamma continuation, whose gamma-log-convex limit is below one. Endpoint-corrected Euler summation gives \(\log R=L_1/k+L_2/k^2+O(k^{-3})\) with the coefficients displayed and proved in RESULT.md, implying the unique shifted root and limiting critical covariance. Independent direct enumeration matched 170 exact rational finite parameter cells, and 8,316 exact rational ratio checks passed. Finite calculations are not the proof of universal or asymptotic quantifiers.

value.rationale: Both unseen-category and doubleton counts are canonical frequency-of-frequencies statistics in species coverage and richness estimation; the sign of their dependence matters for joint variance calculations. At small sample size doubletons coexist with more unobserved categories, but under high load they reduce the number of empty categories; the theorem proves the transition exactly once over the whole finite model. The threshold has a nontrivial shape-dependent constant correction, with an exact Bose–Einstein benchmark and finite critical covariance profile invisible in first-order asymptotics. No broad downstream theorem is claimed or needed for this concrete structural classification.
